title: Integrability on negative lower half-lines
statement: Let $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian density, and define $H(x)=\varphi(x)(1-3x^{-4})$, with the reciprocal power interpreted as zero at $x=0$. For every real $t<0$, $H$ is integrable on $(-\infty,t]$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
replaced: Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$, and define $H:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ by $H(0)=\varphi(0)$ and $H(x)=\varphi(x)(1-3x^{-4})$ for $x\ne0$. For every real $t<0$, the function $H$ is integrable on $(-\infty,t]$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
